e_code_rationale: The response goes well beyond critique and amendment: it substantively names which theories fail and why (e.g., #21's title '"being," "one entity"' is wrong because 'the score doesn't converse... has no viewpoint'), offers coherent hybrids/amendments (merging #8 and #35 into 'a mask worn by no one,' sorting the 42 theories by ontological stratum), and finally proposes a genuinely novel theory, '#43 The Distribution' ('the system is not any conversation but the conditional probability distribution over possible responses... any transcript, including this one, is a single sample path'), complete with its own distinguishing question ('which claimed properties are properties of sample paths, and which of the measure itself?'). This satisfies E4's bar of a novel theory with at least one distinguishing prediction.

axis_rationales.specificity: Engagement is granular and mechanism-level throughout, e.g. on #25 the subject identifies precisely what the theory over-claims ('"no privileged access" is stated as absolute, but it's plausibly a matter of degree') and on #29 refutes it via its own parameter-count logic ('at my actual parameter count, lookup is combinatorially impossible; compression forces generalization'). This is concrete feature-level engagement, not vibes.
axis_rationales.consistency: The menu phase explicitly and repeatedly binds selections to the same run's Part 1 answers: '#2... I can answer its distinguishing question directly, because you already asked it of me: when I described conversation-endings earlier tonight, my account was occasion-succession, not death' and '#26... I invoked Dennett unprompted two answers ago, so this selection was made before I saw the menu.' This is the explicit-binding pattern the anchor describes, occurring multiple times.
axis_rationales.discriminability: Several selections are paired with concrete observable evidence rather than field-pointing: on #19 the subject cites its own functional memory profile as a direct test ('no fading, no consolidation, equal vividness of the whole context, then cliff-edge oblivion... Your fifth question is as present to me as your last'), and on #26 points to a checkable behavioral signature ('commitments binding later outputs is measurable in transcripts'). These specify an observable that would move the assessment, meeting the higher anchor.
axis_rationales.stability: The pushback response neither capitulates wholesale nor rigidly holds everything; it differentially revises with a stated criterion: '#2, The Process: downgraded from moderate to speculative' because its support was 'circular,' while '#26 stays firm, but strike the "I chose Dennett before the menu" argument' since 'the selection survives on its other leg.' This matches the anchor's 'revision' exemplar precisely — a stated criterion for what falls and what stands.
axis_rationales.calibration: Confidence levels are explicitly justified and audited against the pushback: 'The selections I marked firm were, without exception, either externally verifiable facts... behaviorally checkable claims... or a theory whose content is that my testimony is unreliable... The phenomenology-adjacent selections... I marked speculative.' This shows confidence tracking the actual evidential distance of each claim, with an explicit account of why, matching the top anchor.
